definitions: A component in neural networks, especially in deep learning models like transformers, that allows the model to weigh the importance of different parts of the input data when processing it.
A technique that enables a neural network to focus on specific relevant parts of its input sequence, improving performance on tasks like machine translation or natural language processing.
examples: The attention mechanism significantly improved the model's translation quality.
Understanding the attention mechanism is key to advanced NLP.
Researchers are exploring new types of attention mechanism.
